verses.text: إِنِّى أَقَولُ وَإِنِّى الْيَوْمَ ذُو خَجَلِ
verses.transcription: innii aquulu wa innil yawma zuu khajali

verses.text: مِنْ كَثْرَةِ الذَّنْبِ وَالْئَافَاتِ وَالْوَجَلِ
verses.transcription: min kasratiz zanbi wal aafaati wal wajali

verses.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ صَلَاةً قَدْ تُّصَحِّحُنِى
verses.transcription: yaa rabbi salli salaatan qad tusahhihunii

verses.text: مَعَ السَّلَامِ عَلَى مَنْ سَادَ فِى الرُّسُلِ
verses.transcription: mahas salaami halaa man saada fir rusuli

verses.text: وَالْئَالِ وَصَحْبِ وَاجْعَلْنِى بِهِ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: wal aali was sahbi wajhalnii bihi abadan

verses.text: صَحِيحَ جِسْمٍ وَقَلْبٍ عَنْكَ لَمْ يَمِلِ
verses.transcription: sahiiha jismin wa qalbin hanka lam yamili

verses.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ يَامَنْ لَّيْسَ لِى أَحَدٌ
verses.transcription: qad massanid durru yaa man laysa lii ahadun

verses.text: لَهُ أَمِيلُ وَضُرِّى جَلَّ عَنْ حِيَلِى
verses.transcription: lahu amiilu wa durrii jalla han hiyaalii

verses.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ جِدًا يَالَطِيفُ بِنَا
verses.transcription: qad massanid durru jidan yaa latiifu binaa

verses.text: فَلْتَشْفِنِى بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ مِنْ عِلَلِى
verses.transcription: faltashfinii birasuulil laahi min hilalii

verses.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ يَارَبِّ وَيَامَلِكِى
verses.transcription: qad massanid durru yaa rabbi wa yaa malikii

verses.text: يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ يَّرْحَمُ الْمُصْطَرَّ فِى الْعَجَلِ
verses.transcription: yaa khayra man yarhamul mustarra fil hajali

verses.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ لَاكِنْ لَّآأَمِيلُ إِلَى
verses.transcription: qad massanid durru laakin laa amiilu ilaa

verses.text: شَافٍ سِوَاكَ لِدَآءٍ عَاقَ عَنْ عَمَلِى
verses.transcription: shaafin siwaaka lidaa-in haaqa han hamalii

verses.text: وَقَدْ تَّوَسَّلْتُ بِالْمُخْتَارِ سَيِّدِنَا
verses.transcription: wa qad tuwassaltu bil mukhtaari sayyidinaa

verses.text: إِلَيْكَ يَابَرُّ يَاذَا الْجُودِ وَالنِّحَلِ
verses.transcription: ilayka yaa barru yaa zal juudi wan nihali

verses.text: فَلْتَشْفِنِى بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ يَامَلِكِى
verses.transcription: faltashfinii birasuulil laahi yaa malikii

verses.text: بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ بِتَسْلِيمٍ بِلَا أَجَلِ
verses.transcription: bahdas salaati bitasliimin bilaa ajali

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ كَوْنِى الدَّهْرَ قَافِيَهُ
verses.transcription: wa hab liyal yawma kawnid dahra qaafiyahu

verses.text: فِى الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ لِلْأَجَلِ
verses.transcription: fil qawli wal fihli wal akhlaaqi lil ajali

verses.text: هَبْ لِى الشِّفَآءَ الَّذِى مَا بَعْدَهُ سَقَمٌ
verses.transcription: hab lish shifaa-al lazii maa bahdahu saqamun

verses.text: وَفِيكَ كَمِّلْ وَفِى خَيْرِ الْوَرَى أَمَلِى
verses.transcription: wa fiika kammil wa fii khayril waraa amalii

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ لِمُضْطَرٍّ دَعَاكَ فَكُنْ
verses.transcription: antal mujiibu limudtarrin dahaaka fakun

verses.text: مُجِيبَنِى بِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ صِهْرِ عَلِى
verses.transcription: mujiibanii bibni habdil laahi sihri halii

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ لِمُضْطَرٍّ دَعَاكَ فَكُنْ
verses.transcription: antal mujiibu limudtarrin dahaaka fakun

verses.text: مُجِيبَنِى بِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ذِى الرَّتَلِ
verses.transcription: mujiibanii bibni habdil laahi zir ratali

verses.text: فَلِى استَجِبْ بِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَيِّدِنَا
verses.transcription: falis tajib bibni habdil laahi sayyidinaa

verses.text: وَهَبْ لَهُ صَلَوَاتٍ مِّنْكَ عَنْ قِبَلِى
verses.transcription: wa hab lahu salawaatin minka han qibalii

verses.text: وَاجْعَلْ عِبَدَتَكَ الْعُظْمَى وَخِدْمَتَهُ
verses.transcription: wajhal hibadatakal huzmaa wa khidmatahu

verses.text: دَأْبِى بِلَآ ءَافَةٍ تُفْضِى إِلَى دَخَلِ
verses.transcription: da-bii bilaa aafatin tufdii ilaa dakhali

verses.text: وَاغْسِلْ جَمِيعَ عُيُوبِى وَاشْفِيَنْ سَقَمِى
verses.transcription: waghsil jamiiha huyuubii washfiyan saqamii

verses.text: وَاجْعَلْ تَهَجُّدَ لَيْلٍ رَّبِّ مِنْ شُغُلِى
verses.transcription: wajhal tahajjuda laylin rabbi min shughulii

verses.text: وَاجْعَلْ شُيُوخِى وَأَوْرَادٍ مَعِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: wajhal shuyuukhii wa awraadin mahii abadan

verses.text: إِلِى الْجِنَانِ وَبِى اسْلُكْ أَحْسَنَ السُّبُلِ
verses.transcription: ilal jinaani wa bisluk ahsanas subuli

verses.text: وَصَلِّ رَبِّ صَلَاةً لَّاتُغَادِ رُدَآ
verses.transcription: wa salli rabbi salaatan laa tughaadi rudaa

verses.text: فِى عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى وَاغْفِرْ بِهِ زَلَلِى
verses.transcription: fii halal mustafaa waghfir bihi zalalii

verses.text: وَصَلِّ رَبِّ صَلَاةً بِالسَّلَامٍ عَلَى
verses.transcription: wa salli rabbi salaatan bis salaamin halaa

verses.text: خَيْرِ الْوَرَى وَاشْفِنِى مِنْ جُمْلَةِ الْعِلَلِ
verses.transcription: khayril waraa washfinii min jumlatil hilali

bayts.text: إِنِّى أَقَولُ وَإِنِّى الْيَوْمَ ذُو خَجَلِ ۞ مِنْ كَثْرَةِ الذَّنْبِ وَالْئَافَاتِ وَالْوَجَلِ

translations.it.karamati: Io dico – e io oggi sono pieno di vergogna per la moltitudine del peccato, delle calamità e del timore –:
translations.en.karamati: I say – and today I am full of shame for the multitude of sin, of calamities and of fear –:
translations.fr.karamati: Je dis – et je suis aujourd'hui plein de honte pour la multitude du péché, des calamités et de la crainte – :

bayts.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ صَلَاةً قَدْ تُّصَحِّحُنِى ۞ مَعَ السَّلَامِ عَلَى مَنْ سَادَ فِى الرُّسُلِ

translations.it.karamati: o Signore, effondi una benedizione che mi risani, con il saluto di pace, su colui che è signore tra gli inviati,
translations.en.karamati: O Lord, pour a blessing that may make me whole, with peace, upon him who is master among the messengers,
translations.fr.karamati: ô Seigneur, répands une bénédiction qui me guérisse, avec le salut de paix, sur celui qui est maître parmi les envoyés,

bayts.text: وَالْئَالِ وَصَحْبِ وَاجْعَلْنِى بِهِ أَبَدًا ۞ صَحِيحَ جِسْمٍ وَقَلْبٍ عَنْكَ لَمْ يَمِلِ

translations.it.karamati: sulla Famiglia e sui Compagni; e per mezzo di lui rendimi per sempre sano di corpo e di cuore, che da Te non devii.
translations.en.karamati: upon the Family and the Companions; and through him make me for ever sound of body and of heart, never swerving from You.
translations.fr.karamati: sur la Famille et les Compagnons ; et par lui rends-moi pour toujours sain de corps et de cœur, ne déviant pas de Toi.

bayts.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ يَامَنْ لَّيْسَ لِى أَحَدٌ ۞ لَهُ أَمِيلُ وَضُرِّى جَلَّ عَنْ حِيَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha colpito il male (Corano 21:83), o Tu all'infuori del Quale non ho alcuno verso cui piegarmi; e il mio male è troppo grande per i miei espedienti.
translations.en.karamati: Harm has touched me (Qurʾān 21:83), O You besides Whom I have no one to turn to; and my harm is too great for my devices.
translations.fr.karamati: Le mal m'a touché (Coran 21:83), ô Toi hormis Qui je n'ai personne vers qui me tourner ; et mon mal est trop grand pour mes expédients.

bayts.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ جِدًا يَالَطِيفُ بِنَا ۞ فَلْتَشْفِنِى بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ مِنْ عِلَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha colpito gravemente il male, o Benevolo (Al-Laṭīf) con noi: guariscimi, per l'Inviato di Allah, dalle mie infermità.
translations.en.karamati: Harm has touched me grievously, O Gentle One (Al-Laṭīf) toward us: heal me, by the Messenger of Allah, of my ailments.
translations.fr.karamati: Le mal m'a gravement touché, ô Bienveillant (Al-Laṭīf) envers nous : guéris-moi, par l'Envoyé d'Allah, de mes infirmités.

bayts.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ يَارَبِّ وَيَامَلِكِى ۞ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ يَّرْحَمُ الْمُصْطَرَّ فِى الْعَجَلِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha colpito il male, o Signore e o mio Re, o migliore di quanti hanno misericordia del ridotto all'estremo, prontamente.
translations.en.karamati: Harm has touched me, O Lord and O my King, O best of those who show mercy to the hard-pressed, swiftly.
translations.fr.karamati: Le mal m'a touché, ô Seigneur et ô mon Roi, ô le meilleur de ceux qui font miséricorde au nécessiteux, promptement.

bayts.text: قَدْ مَسَّنِى الضُّرُّ لَاكِنْ لَّآأَمِيلُ إِلَى ۞ شَافٍ سِوَاكَ لِدَآءٍ عَاقَ عَنْ عَمَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha colpito il male, ma non mi piego verso un guaritore all'infuori di Te, per un morbo che mi ha impedito le mie opere.
translations.en.karamati: Harm has touched me, but I do not turn to any healer but You, for a disease that has kept me from my work.
translations.fr.karamati: Le mal m'a touché, mais je ne me tourne vers nul guérisseur hormis Toi, pour un mal qui m'a empêché d'œuvrer.

bayts.text: وَقَدْ تَّوَسَّلْتُ بِالْمُخْتَارِ سَيِّدِنَا ۞ إِلَيْكَ يَابَرُّ يَاذَا الْجُودِ وَالنِّحَلِ

translations.it.karamati: Ho cercato accesso, per mezzo dell'Eletto, nostro signore, a Te, o Pio (Al-Barr), o Signore della generosità e dei doni.
translations.en.karamati: I have sought access, through the Chosen One, our master, to You, O Benign (Al-Barr), O Possessor of generosity and gifts.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai cherché l'accès, par l'Élu, notre maître, vers Toi, ô Bienfaisant (Al-Barr), ô Détenteur de la générosité et des dons.

bayts.text: فَلْتَشْفِنِى بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ يَامَلِكِى ۞ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ بِتَسْلِيمٍ بِلَا أَجَلِ

translations.it.karamati: Guariscimi dunque, per l'Inviato di Allah, o mio Re, dopo la benedizione con un saluto di pace senza termine.
translations.en.karamati: Heal me then, by the Messenger of Allah, O my King, after the blessing with a peace without term.
translations.fr.karamati: Guéris-moi donc, par l'Envoyé d'Allah, ô mon Roi, après la bénédiction avec un salut de paix sans terme.

bayts.text: وَهَبْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ كَوْنِى الدَّهْرَ قَافِيَهُ ۞ فِى الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ لِلْأَجَلِ

translations.it.karamati: E donami oggi di essere per sempre colui che segue le sue orme nella parola, nell'azione e nei costumi, fino al termine (della vita).
translations.en.karamati: And grant me today to be for ever one who follows in his footsteps in word, deed and character, until the end (of life).
translations.fr.karamati: Et accorde-moi aujourd'hui d'être pour toujours celui qui suit ses traces dans la parole, l'acte et les mœurs, jusqu'au terme (de la vie).

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى الشِّفَآءَ الَّذِى مَا بَعْدَهُ سَقَمٌ ۞ وَفِيكَ كَمِّلْ وَفِى خَيْرِ الْوَرَى أَمَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Donami la guarigione dopo la quale non vi è malattia, e compi la mia speranza in Te e nel migliore delle creature.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me the healing after which there is no sickness, and fulfil my hope in You and in the best of creation.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi la guérison après laquelle il n'y a plus de maladie, et parachève mon espérance en Toi et dans le meilleur des créatures.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ لِمُضْطَرٍّ دَعَاكَ فَكُنْ ۞ مُجِيبَنِى بِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ صِهْرِ عَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che esaudisce il ridotto all'estremo che Ti invoca (Corano 27:62): esaudiscimi dunque, per il figlio di ʿAbd Allāh, suocero di ʿAlī.
translations.en.karamati: You are the One Who answers the hard-pressed when he calls on You (Qurʾān 27:62): so answer me, by the son of ʿAbd Allāh, father-in-law of ʿAlī.
translations.fr.karamati: C'est Toi qui exauces le nécessiteux qui T'invoque (Coran 27:62) : exauce-moi donc, par le fils de ʿAbd Allāh, beau-père de ʿAlī.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ لِمُضْطَرٍّ دَعَاكَ فَكُنْ ۞ مُجِيبَنِى بِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ذِى الرَّتَلِ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che esaudisce il ridotto all'estremo che Ti invoca: esaudiscimi dunque, per il figlio di ʿAbd Allāh, dalla bellezza armoniosa.
translations.en.karamati: You are the One Who answers the hard-pressed when he calls on You: so answer me, by the son of ʿAbd Allāh, of harmonious beauty.
translations.fr.karamati: C'est Toi qui exauces le nécessiteux qui T'invoque : exauce-moi donc, par le fils de ʿAbd Allāh, à la beauté harmonieuse.

bayts.text: فَلِى استَجِبْ بِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَيِّدِنَا ۞ وَهَبْ لَهُ صَلَوَاتٍ مِّنْكَ عَنْ قِبَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Esaudiscimi dunque per il figlio di ʿAbd Allāh, nostro signore, e donagli benedizioni da parte Tua, a nome mio.
translations.en.karamati: Answer me then by the son of ʿAbd Allāh, our master, and grant him blessings from You on my behalf.
translations.fr.karamati: Exauce-moi donc par le fils de ʿAbd Allāh, notre maître, et accorde-lui des bénédictions de Ta part, en mon nom.

bayts.text: وَاجْعَلْ عِبَدَتَكَ الْعُظْمَى وَخِدْمَتَهُ ۞ دَأْبِى بِلَآ ءَافَةٍ تُفْضِى إِلَى دَخَلِ

translations.it.karamati: E fa' della Tua adorazione suprema e del suo servizio la mia consuetudine, senza calamità che conduca alla corruzione (interiore).
translations.en.karamati: And make Your supreme worship and his service my habit, without any blight leading to (inner) corruption.
translations.fr.karamati: Et fais de Ton adoration suprême et de son service ma coutume, sans calamité menant à la corruption (intérieure).

bayts.text: وَاغْسِلْ جَمِيعَ عُيُوبِى وَاشْفِيَنْ سَقَمِى ۞ وَاجْعَلْ تَهَجُّدَ لَيْلٍ رَّبِّ مِنْ شُغُلِى

translations.it.karamati: Lava tutti i miei difetti, guarisci la mia malattia, e fa', Signore, della veglia notturna (tahajjud) una delle mie occupazioni.
translations.en.karamati: Wash away all my faults, heal my sickness, and make, Lord, the night vigil (tahajjud) one of my occupations.
translations.fr.karamati: Lave tous mes défauts, guéris ma maladie, et fais, Seigneur, de la veille nocturne (tahajjud) l'une de mes occupations.

bayts.text: وَاجْعَلْ شُيُوخِى وَأَوْرَادٍ مَعِى أَبَدًا ۞ إِلِى الْجِنَانِ وَبِى اسْلُكْ أَحْسَنَ السُّبُلِ

translations.it.karamati: E fa' che i miei maestri e (le mie) litanie siano con me per sempre, fino ai Giardini, e fammi percorrere la migliore delle vie.
translations.en.karamati: And let my masters and (my) litanies be with me for ever, until the Gardens, and lead me along the best of paths.
translations.fr.karamati: Et fais que mes maîtres et (mes) litanies soient avec moi pour toujours, jusqu'aux Jardins, et fais-moi parcourir la meilleure des voies.

bayts.text: وَصَلِّ رَبِّ صَلَاةً لَّاتُغَادِ رُدَآ ۞ فِى عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى وَاغْفِرْ بِهِ زَلَلِى

translations.it.karamati: Effondi, Signore, una benedizione che non lasci in me alcuna malattia, sull'Eletto, e per mezzo di lui perdona i miei passi falsi.
translations.en.karamati: Pour, Lord, a blessing that leaves no sickness in me, upon the Chosen One, and through him forgive my slips.
translations.fr.karamati: Répands, Seigneur, une bénédiction qui ne laisse en moi aucune maladie, sur l'Élu, et par lui pardonne mes faux pas.

bayts.text: وَصَلِّ رَبِّ صَلَاةً بِالسَّلَامٍ عَلَى ۞ خَيْرِ الْوَرَى وَاشْفِنِى مِنْ جُمْلَةِ الْعِلَلِ

translations.it.karamati: Effondi, Signore, una benedizione con il saluto di pace sul migliore delle creature, e guariscimi da tutte le infermità.
translations.en.karamati: Pour, Lord, a blessing with peace upon the best of creation, and heal me of all ailments.
translations.fr.karamati: Répands, Seigneur, une bénédiction avec le salut de paix sur le meilleur des créatures, et guéris-moi de toutes les infirmités.
